Roquinimex (USAN, rINN) FCF-89; LS-2616; Roquinimexum. 1,2-Dihydro-4-hydroxy-N,1- dimethyl-2-oxo-3-quinolinecarboxanilide. Рохинимекс C18H16N2O3 = 308.3. CAS — 84088-42-6. ATC — L03AX02. ATC Vet — QL03AX02. Profile Roquinimex is an immunomodulator reported to stimulate vari- ous immune functions including macrophage cytotoxicity. It has been investigated for its potential against malignant neoplasms including as adjuvant therapy after bone marrow transplantation in acute leukaemia, to prolong the time to relapse. Roquinimex has also been investigated in immune and auto-immune disor- ders including multiple sclerosis. However serious cardiovascu- lar toxicity after roquinimex therapy has led to several studies being terminated. ◊ References. 1. Coutant R, et al. Linomide in relapsing and secondary pro- gressive MS. Part 1: trial design and clinical results. Neurology 2000; 54: 1726–33.
